# <span id="aanchor313"></span> <span id="aanchor314"></span> Reports

Several chart reports are available within FLOWCAL:

- Bar Code Labels
- Chart Batch Contents
- Chart Tracking Status
- Operator Statistics Detail
- Operator Statistics Summary

<div class="procedure">

To access the Chart Reports screen:

Go to **Tools** \> **Charts** \> **Reports**.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 403;height: 283;" />

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Details">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Chart Report Details</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Details">

The following options are available in the Chart Reports screen:

- **Reprint Labels** - Print labels that have been printed previously.

- **Show All Lists** - By default, lists are filtered by ordered lists, unless this option is checked.

  The List drop-down only contains ordered lists; this function does not support static or dynamic lists.

- **Collation**
  - **By Date** – When running a report for an ordered list of meters from January 2017 through December 2017, the report will run all meters for January, then all meters for February, through December.
  - **By Meter** – When running report for an ordered list of meters from January 2017 through December 2017, the report will run data for the first meter from January through December, then data for the second meter from January through December, until the last meter has been processed.

</div>
